Even if an attacker captures a password, they cannot access the account without the second factor (like a hardware key or an authenticator app code).Domain Monitoring: Organizations often monitor for "typosquatted" domains (e.g., g00gle.com instead of google.com) that might be used in attacks.HTTPS & Certificates: While many phishing sites now use HTTPS, users should always inspect the URL.
